=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "spec" "new"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Write specs/<release>/<feature>/prd.md and trd.md into the knowledge clone from its templates,
| with status draft and rev 1. Refuses a folder that exists; writes a missing template first. Runs no git.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew spec new <feature> [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml; its branch gives the default release.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --clone      Knowledge clone to write into; defaults to the profile's ~/.dashcrew/knowledge/<name>.
|     --release    Release folder; defaults to the release the current branch records, else unreleased.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)
